editorial:
Imagine a world where the goddess of birth has a literal checklist for every baby born. You get to follow her as she visits a busy hospital to make sure a little boy gets his lucky start in life. But things go sideways when a grumpy ghost decides to mess with the plan, swapping the baby's fate. It feels like a cozy fairy tale mixed with a hospital drama, and the vibe is surprisingly sweet. You will find yourself rooting for the goddess as she tries to fix the mistake before it is too late, making the whole experience feel like a warm hug.

What really works here is the acting and the way the movie keeps you guessing about the ghost's motives. The pacing is smooth, though a few parts drag a bit in the middle. If you like stories about destiny and magic in the real world, you will love this.
endingExplained: The story wraps up when the goddess finally outsmarts the ghost to fix the baby's destiny. You see the baby grow up with the luck and health he was always meant to have. The ghost learns a lesson about letting go of the past and finally finds peace. It ends on a happy note, showing that love and a little bit of divine help can overcome any bad luck or mistake.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartwarming stories about fate and magic.
